titleByLocale.it: Global Markets - Responsabile delle Relazioni di Compensazione

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a client focused individual with a passion for business enablement and building long-term partnerships? We’re looking for someone like you to:
• Partner with Sales to support conversion of new clearing opportunities, including pitches for new business and participate in client meetings for clearing domain topic expertise
• Provide support to accelerate and more effectively manage complex mandate go-lives
• Deliver UBS’ product, service and platform capabilities to clients, capturing client feedback on product offering and proactively identifying ways to partner on new business or service optimization
• Build a deep understanding of clients and their needs and challenges, prioritizing impactful enhancements addressing their requirements
• Stay informed about broader industry and regulatory development to deliver content and insights that will differentiate UBS as a strategic clearing partner and deepen existing relationships
• Manage relationships with exchanges, CCPs and other market infrastructure partners, understand their roadmap to drive business development and ensure clients are informed and supported on market developments
